position.normalization: x_wrapped = rem_euclid(x, L); x_unit = x_wrapped / L
position.units: declared per physical task; identical for candidate and reference

velocity.units: declared per physical task; identical for candidate and reference

characteristic_signature.definition: mu_hat(k, eta) = sum_i w_i * exp(i * (2*pi*k*x_i/L + eta*(v_i-v_ref)/v_scale))
characteristic_signature.finite_feature_aliasing_warning: Distinct measures can share a finite characteristic signature.

comparison.normalization: max(total_variation(candidate), total_variation(reference)); use 1 when both are zero
comparison.particle_count_role: metadata-only; not part of the distance
comparison.exact_representation_equivalence_target: relative error <= 1e-12 for deterministic f64 permutation, periodic representative, and co-located split/merge fixtures

provenance_requirements.train_test_split: split by independent trajectories and seeds; never by randomly partitioning correlated snapshots alone

required_negative_controls: same position marginal but changed velocity-position pairing
same positions and velocities but changed total signed weight
finite feature set aliasing example documented as a known limitation

prohibited_claims: standalone acceptance gate for learned field proposals
SOTA superiority without matched independent experiments

implementation.complexity: O(N_particles * N_modes) arithmetic and O(N_modes) output storage
implementation.implementation_status: source-authored; Rust compile/test/Clippy not yet independently observed
